answer: Hold every payout on a public quarantine ledge for one challenge window before it settles. Any staked participant may signal a challenge against a claim with a matching bond; the protocol re-executes that claim against its inputs, and whoever is wrong, padder or false accuser, forfeits the bond to the other. Since catching a fake pays, duplicated output across a farm's aliases becomes a standing target: each extra fake adds a claim exposed to profit-seeking challengers, so the ivory tower of fake volume carries tail risk that grows with its size. Honest work survives re-execution and settles.
